title: Intensive Elementary Korean II
description:
Prerequisite: KORA101, KORA103 or equivalent, as determined by the Foreign Language Placement Assessment (FLPA), and permission of ARHU-School of Languages, Literatures, and Cultures department.
Restriction: Registration limited to students accepted into the Summer Language Institute.
Credit only granted for: KORA 102 or KORA 104. Intensive training at the elementary level in spoken Korean including the use of various speech styles, through a highly interactive approach. Continues to build and enhance accuracy in basic literacy skills, vocabulary, and grammar, as well as situational appropriateness. Substantial cultural component familiarizes students with various aspects of Korean culture. Taught in Korean.
